theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Set (Euclid n)) (R C : ℝ) (w : Euclid n), MeasurableSet F → (∀ g : Euclid n → Euclid n, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) (R + ‖w‖) → (∀ z, ‖g z‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ z in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid n) (fderiv ℝ g z : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid n) ≤ C) → ∫ z in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, |F.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z - F.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (z - w)| ≤ ‖w‖ * C
